name: The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place
short_description: An intimate all-suite Ritz-Carlton on the upper floors of a tower above Pacific Place mall in Jakarta's SCBD, with a Club Lounge open to every guest, an outdoor pool, spa and Indonesia's largest hotel ballroom.
ai_summary: The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place is an intimate luxury hotel occupying the upper floors of a tower rising above the Pacific Place mall in the Sudirman Central Business District (SCBD) of South Jakarta. It is distinct from the sibling Ritz-Carlton Jakarta in Mega Kuningan; this property is directly connected to the mall and steps from the Indonesia Stock Exchange. With only about 62 oversized suites, reviewers repeatedly describe it as feeling more like a sophisticated boutique than a big-city high-rise, with spacious rooms (entry suites over 100 sqm) and sweeping night views across Jakarta. Its signature is a Club Lounge on Level 21 that is complimentary for all guests regardless of room category, serving breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, an evening welcome ceremony and cocktails; independent bloggers rate it a cut above typical executive lounges. All-day dining PA.SO.LA sits on Level 6, a spa and fitness club on Level 8, plus an outdoor pool terrace and the Grand Ballroom, billed as Indonesia's largest. Service earns near-universal praise for warmth and butler attentiveness. Watchouts: the pool is small, some amenities have shown wear or brand substitution, and airport transfers can run 45-90 minutes in traffic.

core_facts.address: Sudirman Central Business District (SCBD), Jl. Jend. Sudirman Kav. 52-53, Pacific Place, Jakarta 12190, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Room upgrades for Platinum Elite and above, subject to availability
Complimentary breakfast or bonus points for Platinum Elite and above, per Marriott Bonvoy program terms

pros: Complimentary Club Lounge (Level 21) for every guest, with five daily food-and-drink services widely praised as above typical executive lounges
Warm, attentive, name-remembering service including butler assistance
Very spacious all-suite accommodations (entry suites 100+ sqm) with strong city views
Prime SCBD location directly connected to Pacific Place mall and near the Stock Exchange
cons: Outdoor pool is small for a hotel of this calibre
Some reviewers noted worn amenities or substituted bath products (property dates to 2007, renovated 2021)
Airport transfers can take 45-90 minutes in Jakarta traffic
research_highlights: All-suite property of ~62 rooms; Club Lounge free for all guests is the standout differentiator
Directly mall-connected in SCBD with sheltered access to shopping and dining
Home to the Grand Ballroom, promoted as Indonesia's largest hotel ballroom
research_watchouts: Must not be confused with the Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan (a separate hotel)
Exact room count (~62) and floor spread cited from independent blogs/Forbes; official Marriott page did not confirm during research

faqs.question: Is this the same as the Ritz-Carlton in Mega Kuningan?
faqs.answer: No. This is the Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place, set above the Pacific Place mall in SCBD/Sudirman. The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan is a separate, larger property in a different neighbourhood.

faqs.question: Do all guests get Club Lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. Independent reviewers confirm the Club Lounge on Level 21 is complimentary for every guest regardless of room type, offering breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, an evening welcome ceremony and cocktails.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport?
faqs.answer: It is roughly 30 km from Soekarno-Hatta (CGK); expect about 45 minutes to 1.5 hours by car depending on traffic.

reviews.title: [Hotel Review] The Ritz Carlton, Jakarta, Pacific Place
reviews.author: Satu Kosong
reviews.summary: Blogger calls it the best Ritz-Carlton experience ever: a spacious 104 sqm suite, warm elite recognition, and a Level 21 Club Lounge with breakfast, light lunch, afternoon tea and cocktails. Direct access to Pacific Place mall.

reviews.title: Review: The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place (Large Corner Suite)
reviews.author: Fai
reviews.summary: Modern 104 sqm Large Corner Suite with open plan; service rated 10/10. Club Lounge, free for all guests with strong food and creative cocktails, is a highlight. Gripes: substituted (non-Asprey) bath products and a non-working sauna.
